# Nihilo Solutions
> Secure, tenant-local RAG and LLM Ops consulting for enterprise Azure and AWS environments.

## Core Services
- [Home](https://nihilosolutions.com/): Overview of Nihilo's mission to enable secure agentic automation.
- [AI Assessment](https://nihilosolutions.com/assessment): A framework for evaluating enterprise LLM readiness and ROI.
- [Security Architecture](https://nihilosolutions.com/security): Details on zero-data-retention patterns and tenant-local vector databases.

## Resources

- Governance: SOC2 compliance patterns, BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) integration.
